# E-M5 III 1.7: Color / Monochrome Profile editor on the camera

Modes selectable, wheels drawn, edits seen in live view and photos, over a series of test builds.

**physical camera; reported pass; partial report; not applicable.**

**Camera:** [Olympus OM-D E-M5 Mark III](../cameras/em5-iii.md) · **Project:** [Olympus firmware notes (E-M5 Mark III)](../projects/em5-iii-notes.md)

**Firmware:** [E-M5 Mark III firmware 1.7, build 1700](../firmware/em5-iii-1700.md) · **Mod build:** unpublished test builds (2026-11-19 to 2026-11-20)

**Provenance:** firsthand tester report. **Reported:** 2026-11-20. **Test date:** 2026-11-20.

**Reported/observed package SHA-256:** not recorded.

## Procedure and coverage

Test builds flashed from the SD card, one change at a time; each run checked the editor screen, live view and a photo, and when the screen stayed empty the camera's debug shell was used to dump the drawing buffers and display state.

- Profile entries and slot survive power-off.
- Colour and mono wheels drawn; labels, hold-OK reset and the colour box follow the edits.
- Colour and mono edits seen in live view and in photos.
- Per-slot sharpness and contrast from the Super Control Panel; side-bar rows and sliders work.

## Limits and assumptions

- One camera, one owner; a series of test builds, not one package.
- The last builds of the series were still being run when this was written.
